title: Record the omitted-closure partition in the intake family order
body:
## Summary
- In the published family order, 24 of the 564 intake rows omit `closure`. Every intake row still carries `review_completion` and `verification_evidence`.
- Four omitted rows inherit an explicit null (1365, 1494, 2361, 2832). Row 2963 records null with no earlier closure. The other 19 omit the field in the ledger as well.
- Partial, no new kappa. The ledger and the family files are unchanged.
